column1: Intel is an industry leader, creating world-changing technology that enables global progress and enriches lives. Inspired
by Moore's Law, we continuously work to advance the design and manufacturing of semiconductors to help address our
customers' greatest challenges. By embedding intelligence in the cloud, network, edge, and every kind of computing device,
we unleash the potential of data to transform business and society for the better.
